# browser-task-recorder

> Turn recorded browser steps, including Chrome DevTools Recorder JSON exports, into reproducible Playwright Python scripts with safe literals and secrets moved to environment variables Python package `trysac-browser-task-recorder`, import name `browser_task_recorder`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
